CREATE TABLE spaces (
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            name TEXT NOT NULL,
            icon TEXT,
            color TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL

            space_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES spaces(id),
            module_key TEXT NOT NULL,

            PRIMARY KEY (space_id, module_key)
        )
